description: P35 (plan M6-M9 §5.4, §5.7, §2.12): the woodfolk's elder at Hollowmere, who gives the woodfolk's oath (quest.oath_wood). A giant of stage 4 or less meets her among the huts on the pond's south shore; a bigger one on Hollowmere's green beside them (the director moves her: the settlement's POI has max_inner_stage 4). Protected: every blow is refused (still an offence against the woodfolk).
